In the weeks leading up to Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to Delhi on September 12, there was much media speculation that it could lead to major outcomes. Talk circulated of Beijing considering a special investment package, or even setting up a dedicated special economic zone in India. Some analysts even suggested the two leaders could agree to resume an informal dialogue mechanism, following years of fractious relations.
